_about: PARKED: the moveset side of picking up and throwing an object (docs/combat/throwable-cars.md), on Game Design's ruling (rule-of-cool.md, 'Throwables, ruled', 2026-10-17) and Art's mass classes (docs/art/cars.md). The rules are Game Design's and are copied here only so the pieces can be read against them; the pieces, their looks by fighter and the poses each needs are Combat's. Nothing is loaded or hashed

mass._from: docs/art/cars.md (vehicles.json): Art's suggestion, adopted by Game Design

rules.pickUp: A's context, an object within 2 bh while he is free and the rival is beyond striking reach (control-rules.md row 5)
rules.x: a quick low toss along the stick
rules.y: a full throw along the stick
rules.b: the slam: down on a rival in reach, or onto the ground in front of him; holding an object, B is never a launcher
rules.catch: a perfect block of a thrown object within the catcher's tier catches it; he holds it, and his next X or Y throws it back worth a quarter more
rules.swat: above his tier's mass the perfect block swats it aside along his stick: no damage to him; where it lands is on the thrower's account
rules.guard: a plain guard blocks it at the guard's rate

ai._about: by level; no cap and no cooldown

classes._about: the lift by the object's size, in three classes: light (one hand), heavy (two hands, or the Anti-hero's one arm on the plate) and huge (both arms, overhead or to the shoulder)

protagonist.look: the guardian, playful and technical: careful athletic lifts, a turning release; his AI aims away from people and picks up only when that line is clear

pieces.lift.light: one hand under the frame, swung up to the shoulder
pieces.lift.heavy: two open hands under the chassis, the knees bent, stood up with it
pieces.lift.huge: under the middle with both arms, the back straight, raised overhead in two steps
pieces.hold: at the shoulder (light) or overhead (heavy, huge); he flies with it
pieces.toss.x: a side-arm skim, low and flat, released on a quarter turn
pieces.throw.y: a turning heave along the stick: one full turn and the release
pieces.slam.b: on a rival in reach, else the ground in front (the rule, for both): brought down with both hands and a turn of the hips; on the ground it is left standing as a wall between them
pieces.catch: open hands meet it and give with it, a turn absorbing the speed, and it is held at the shoulder
pieces.swat: a palm on its side and a turn, deflecting it along his stick

rival.look: exact and punishing: one arm where one arm will do, the forearm plate as a fork, the straight line; his AI aims through whatever stands behind the rival

pieces.lift.light: picked up by the frame in one hand
pieces.lift.heavy: the forearm plate slid under the frame like a fork, and up on one arm
pieces.lift.huge: the plate under and the free hand on top, both arms, raised to the shoulder
pieces.hold: out on the plate at shoulder height; he flies with it
pieces.toss.x: a short straight push off the plate, low
pieces.throw.y: a straight hurl along the stick
pieces.slam.b: on a rival in reach, else the ground in front (the rule, for both): brought straight down off the plate; on the ground, slammed flat
pieces.catch: stopped dead on the plate, no give, and held there
pieces.swat: a backhand of the plate, aside along his stick

poses._about: an estimate a fighter, Animation's figure to come through the EP; the object is a prop body (Simulation, World's option B), its wreck Art's

legal._about: no row covers a lift of a vehicle (g03 and g04 are written for people); cars hold no one (World's plan; Art's wreck has no people in or around a car)
asks: a row for a lifted or thrown object: drawn whole and in view, no person in it

_rulesSameForBoth: the outcome of every piece is the rule's, the same for both fighters (a slam lands on a rival in reach, a throw goes along the stick); the pieces differ in look, and each AI in where it aims
